title: mboxturbo --json events, version 1
description: One JSON object per line on standard output. A run that fails before the mailbox is open writes only an error event; an info run writes one info event; otherwise the order is start, index, progress (one or more), file, summary, and a failure after start ends the stream with an error event.

oneOf.title: start
oneOf.description: The export is about to run.

oneOf.title: index
oneOf.description: Whether opening the mailbox loaded its index or rebuilt it.

oneOf.title: progress
oneOf.description: At most one per second while writing, then one last event with messages equal to total.

oneOf.title: file
oneOf.description: One output path: the file, or the directory of an eml export.

oneOf.title: summary
oneOf.description: The export finished; the last line of a successful run. excluded_undated is present only when --since or --until was given: the number of messages with no index date, which the bounds exclude.

oneOf.title: info
oneOf.description: The shape of a mailbox, from its index: the message count, the earliest and latest dates as RFC 3339 UTC strings (null when no message has a date) and the number of undated messages.

oneOf.title: error
oneOf.description: The run failed; the last line of a failed run. The code is the process exit code and the message is the line written to standard error.
